# Agent-Safe Takeaways

- Do not equate synthetic structure with observed demographic history.
- Track allele frequencies, heterozygosity, ancestry, and relatedness as separate quantities.
- Use population labels and provenance when choosing association adjustments or reference panels.

# Limitations and Guardrails

- Coalescent panels do not automatically reflect a real breeding pedigree or selected population.
- Use real haplotype panels when empirical LD and allele spectra matter.
